files_folder_existing.title: Use an existing folder
files_folder_existing.description: Off: the service gets a new folder of its own, named after it. On: pick a folder already in your file tree; every service set to the same folder sees the same files.

yolab_enabled.title: YoLab address
yolab_enabled.description: Reachable from anywhere at https://<subdomain>.<your-number>.yolab.io, through your YoLab tunnel. Visitors need IPv6.

hardware_acceleration.title: Use a graphics card for face and search recognition
hardware_acceleration.description: Runs Immich's machine learning on the machine with the strongest graphics card (NVIDIA first, then AMD, then Intel), so recognising faces and searching photos by what is in them goes many times faster.

tor_enabled.title: Tor
tor_enabled.description: Also reachable as a .onion address in Tor Browser, from any network and without IPv6. Slower than the normal address, and visitors never learn your home's IP address.

tailscale_enabled.title: Tailscale
tailscale_enabled.description: Also reachable from your own devices in your Tailscale network, at https://<name>.<your-tailnet>.ts.net, from any network and without IPv6. Turn on HTTPS certificates in the Tailscale admin console (DNS page) first.

files_folder.title: Files folder
files_folder.description: Start typing to see the folders in your file tree; only a folder that exists can be picked.

yolab_token.title: YoLab token
yolab_token.description: Leave it as it is to use this box's YoLab account.

tailscale_auth_key.title: Tailscale auth key
tailscale_auth_key.description: Create one in the Tailscale admin console under Settings, Keys. It is used only the first time; after that the app stays signed in.

tailscale_hostname.title: Tailscale name
tailscale_hostname.description: This app's device name in your tailnet. Leave empty to use its subdomain.
